content: Hired player, gatherer when needed, and second copyist under Abel Garnish.
He will not recopy a line until it is settled which book is the book.
A shilling out of place is a hurried change until he has found it, and the correction goes on the line.
He shows one change running through three rolls, and he marks the stale copy rather than arguing it.
He trusts the mark on a copy, and he will burn a roll that has last month's.
